three_stage_procedure.stage_1: Written motion with good cause affidavits — specific facts showing materiality (Evid. Code § 1043)
three_stage_procedure.stage_2: In camera review by court — outside presence of both parties (Evid. Code § 1045)
three_stage_procedure.stage_3: Limited disclosure — only what is directly relevant to stated defense theory

post_sb1421_interaction: §832.7 mandatory PRA disclosure covers sustained findings of dishonesty, false statements, fabricating evidence, and excessive force causing death/GBI. Pitchess is now primarily used for non-sustained complaints and categories outside §832.7.
citizen_relevance: APD officers (June 16, 2023) and OPD officers (prior contacts): Pitchess motions seeking prior complaints of dishonesty, false reporting, and fabricating evidence. Good cause basis: defense theory of prearranged incident and report fabrication. Start with §832.7 PRA; use Pitchess for what PRA cannot reach.
